method: Fresh Blender GLB import, evaluated skinned body + mallet transformed by RightGrip. Triangle BVH crossings at each 60 Hz frame. RightHand >=0.5 on all three vertices excluded only from nonhand counts; mallet head triangles defined by any local Blender Z >0.18 m. Discrete crossing test is not continuous collision detection and does not prove no enclosed-volume penetration.
